N_full_exempt.long_name: Number of students with any vaccination exemption
N_full_exempt.short_description: Number of assessed school students with any exemption (medical or non-medical) from vaccination requirements.
N_full_exempt.long_description: Count of assessed school students with at least one vaccination exemption of any type, combining medical and non-medical exemptions. Reported by some states and left missing where the source publishes only percentages.
N_full_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} school students had a vaccination exemption of any kind.

rate_full_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with any vaccination exemption
rate_full_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with any exemption (medical or non-medical) from vaccination requirements.
rate_full_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students with at least one vaccination exemption of any type, combining medical and non-medical exemptions. Where a state reports the categories separately this is their sum; overlap handling depends on what the source publishes.
rate_full_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a vaccination exemption of any kind.

total_pop_4_18.short_description: Census population aged 4 to 18 in the county.
total_pop_4_18.long_description: Population aged 4 to 18 from census estimates, used as an approximate denominator where the state publishes exemption counts without an enrolment figure. It is a resident population, not an enrolment count, so rates derived from it are approximate.
total_pop_4_18.statement: In {location}, the population aged 4 to 18 was {value}.

N_complete.long_name: Number of kindergarten students with proper immunization documentation
N_complete.short_description: Kindergarten students reported as having proper immunization documentation on file.
N_complete.long_description: Count of kindergarten students (public and private schools, excluding schools for the deaf/blind and virtual schools) with proper immunization documentation, as required by section 1003.22(8), Florida Statutes.
N_complete.statement: In {location}, {value} kindergarten students had proper immunization documentation.

rate_complete.long_name: Proportion of kindergarten students with proper immunization documentation
rate_complete.short_description: Share of kindergarten students reported as having proper immunization documentation on file.
rate_complete.long_description: Share of kindergarten students (public and private schools, excluding schools for the deaf/blind and virtual schools) with proper immunization documentation, as required by section 1003.22(8), Florida Statutes.
rate_complete.statement: In {location}, {value} of kindergarten students had proper immunization documentation.

fl_school_immunization.name: Florida School Immunization Data
fl_school_immunization.description: County-level school immunization data from Florida Health Charts.
fl_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.

fl_kindergarten_immunization_levels.name: Immunization Levels in Kindergarten
fl_kindergarten_immunization_levels.description: County-level percentage of kindergarten students with proper immunization documentation, 2007-2026, from FLHealthCHARTS.
fl_kindergarten_immunization_levels.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
